slides.texte_overlay:
things nobody tells you about
becoming confident

it starts boring

confidence isn't a big moment, it's a hundred boring ones: speaking up once, making the call, asking the question. nobody films the small reps, but they're the whole thing.

the fear doesn't leave

confident people still feel the fear, they just stopped waiting for it to go away first. you act scared until one day you notice you're not as scared anymore.

your body goes first

the way you stand, breathe and walk changes before your thoughts do. fix your posture and slow your voice, and your mind slowly catches up with what your body is already saying.

knowing things helps

having things to talk about makes every room less scary. 5 minutes a day learning about history, science or art gives you quiet confidence in conversations you used to dread.
slides.texte_sophia:
knowing things helps

i used to dread conversations with smart people. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app: history, science, art. it gave me a quiet confidence i never had.

slides.texte_overlay:
some people won't like it

when you start speaking up, a few people will prefer the quieter version of you. that's not a sign you're doing it wrong, it's a sign you're finally doing it at all.
